P.name: Headshot
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Caitlyn's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Count'' {{tip|on-attack}}, doubled if she is within {{tip|brush}}. At 5 stacks, or 4 while in ''brush'', her next basic attack consumes all stacks {{tip|on-attack}} to become a ''Headshot''.
P.description2: {{sbc|Headshot:}} '''Caitlyn's''' basic attack is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and deal {{as|{{pp|key=%|60 to 100 for 3|1 to 13}}|ad}} {{as|(+ {{critical damage|0 to 100|critScaling=true}}) AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, increased to {{as|110% (+ {{critical damage|0 to 100|critScaling=true}}) AD}} against non-champions.
P.description3: Enemies that step over a ''{{ai|Yordle Snap Trap|Caitlyn}}'' or are hit by ''{{ai|90 Caliber Net|Caitlyn}}'' can grant an additional ''Headshot'' against them at {{sti|range|1300 range}} within {{fd|1.8}} seconds, without consuming stacks. Each method grants only one ''Headshot'' at a time.

Q.name: Piltover Peacemaker
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Caitlyn''' fires a piercing shot in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy it passes through, after which it expands in width but deals only 60% damage to enemies it hits thereafter.
Q.description2: Enemies {{tip|true sight|revealed}} by ''{{ai|Yordle Snap Trap|Caitlyn}}'' always take {{ccs|full damage|physical}} from ''Piltover Peacemaker''.

W.name: Yordle Snap Trap
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Caitlyn''' sets a visible trap at the target location that is {{tip|untargetable}} and arms after 1 second, lasting for a duration. The trap grants {{tip|sight}} of the area for 1 second after being placed.
W.description2: '''Caitlyn''' periodically [[ammunition|stocks]] a ''Yordle Snap Trap'' charge, up to a maximum amount. Deploying traps beyond the maximum destroys the oldest one.
W.description3: The next enemy champion that springs the trap is {{tip|root|rooted}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds and {{tip|true sight|revealed}} for 3 seconds, as well as takes additional damage from the ''{{ai|Headshot|Caitlyn}}'' granted by this ability. Trapped targets become immune to further ''Yordle Snap Traps'' for 3 seconds, preventing them from springing subsequent traps for the duration.

E.name: 90 Caliber Net
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Caitlyn''' fires a net in the target direction and {{tip|dash|recoils}} 390 units in the opposite direction. The net deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 50% for 1 second.
E.description2: '''''Caitlyn''' will not recoil after the cast time if she was {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}} during it. She can cast any of her [[champion ability|abilities]] during the recoil dash.''

R.name: Ace in the Hole
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Caitlyn''' locks onto the target enemy champion and {{tip|channel|channels}} for 1 second, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them as well as {{tip|sight|revealing}} herself.
R.description2: ''Ace in the Hole'' is placed on a 5-second {{sti|cooldown}} if canceled.
R.description3: Once '''Caitlyn''' completes the channel, she fires a homing bullet toward the target that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy champion it hits, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 30|critScaling=true}}.
